title: A Small Badge, A Long Story
paras: Mira Das repairs old metal objects for a city museum. The city pays her to save things from its public buildings. She has twelve years of [[experience|experience]], but one small police badge was a new challenge. It was made of [[silver|silver]] and showed a [[panda|panda]] holding a leaf. A retired [[officer|officer]] brought it to her workshop in a blue box. He had worn it while working near the city zoo.

The badge was almost black, and its box had a [[nasty|nasty]] smell after years in a wet cupboard. Mira did not wash everything in the same way. She treated the metal and the cloth inside the box [[differently|differently]]. First, she used a soft, dry brush on the cloth. Then she cleaned the badge slowly. An old photograph helped her understand its shape. She kept a [[copy|copy]] beside her work table.

Mira enjoys [[travelling|travelling]], and this time her work took her to the zoo to learn about the badge. A worker said it was [[possibly|possibly]] designed for the zoo's opening day, but nobody knew for sure. Mira wrote a short note to [[explain|explain]] this mystery. Now the clean badge sits beside its blue box in the museum. Visitors can see both the bright metal and its unfinished story.
zh: 米拉·达斯为一家城市博物馆修复旧金属物品。市政府付钱请她保存公共建筑里的老物件。她有十二年的经验，但一枚小小的警察徽章给她带来了新的挑战。徽章是银制的，上面是一只拿着叶子的大熊猫。一位退休警官把它装在蓝色盒子里，带到了她的工作室。他过去在城市动物园附近工作时，曾佩戴这枚徽章。
徽章几乎全黑了，盒子在潮湿的柜子里放了多年，散发着难闻的气味。米拉没有用同一种方法清洗所有东西。她用不同的方法处理金属和盒内的布。首先，她用柔软的干刷子轻刷那块布。然后，她慢慢清洁徽章。一张老照片帮助她了解徽章原来的样子。她在工作台旁放了一份照片的复制件。
米拉喜欢旅行，这次她因工作来到动物园，了解这枚徽章的故事。一位工作人员说，它可能是为动物园开园那天设计的，但谁也不能确定。米拉写了一段简短的文字，说明这个谜团。如今，清洁后的徽章和蓝色盒子一起陈列在博物馆里。游客既能看到闪亮的金属，也能了解它尚未讲完的故事。

q.s: The retired officer had worked near the zoo for twenty years.
q.why: 文章未说明警官在动物园附近工作了多久。

q.s: Mira cleaned the cloth and the badge using the same method.
q.why: 第二段说她用不同方法处理金属和布。

q.s: The zoo worker was not sure whether the badge was designed for the zoo's opening day.
q.why: 工作人员说可能是，但谁也不能确定。
